attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in RPSG VENTURES LIMITED. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. RPSG VENTURES LIMITED has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: RPSG Ventures Limited responded to the National Stock Exchange regarding a spurt in trading volume on November 17, 2026. The company stated it is not aware of any information, event, or development that may have a bearing on the volume movement. Consequently, the increase in volume appears to be market-driven, and the company is not aware of any specific reason for the same. RPSG Ventures confirmed that it has been furnishing all required events and information to the Stock Exchange under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company further confirmed that as of the date of the letter, there is no undisclosed information or event requiring disclosure under Regulation 30. The company committed to making appropriate disclosures as and when required in accordance with applicable SEBI Listing Regulations. Sudip Kumar Ghosh, Compliance Officer, signed the letter on behalf of RPSG Ventures Limited.
